subject: Next steps: procurement & marketplace path (NimbusAI)
messages: Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks again for the time today — really enjoyed learning more about NimbusAI's production goals and the plan to embed Redwood behind your feature flags. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move procurement forward:

1) Procurement path: you mentioned finance prefers a PO for enterprise purchases but your Platform team is open to marketplace procurement if we can support AWS Marketplace private offers. Can you confirm whether purchase via PO (invoice) or AWS Marketplace (PO through private offer) is the preferred option for initial pilot?

2) Billing & legal: you flagged SOC 2 evidence and an ordering doc. I attached our pricing + a standard SOW template for scope and timelines. If procurement wants a consolidated quote for PO, we can produce a signed order form + SOW. If you go marketplace, procurement will likely need the Marketplace listing terms + any MSA summary we can provide.
3) Timeline & approvals: you mentioned a target pilot start in September. Who is the procurement contact we should loop in to get the PO timeline? Is it the same procurement alias you CC'd earlier?

4) Marketplace interest: we support AWS Marketplace (private offers) and are in early stages for GCP/Azure marketplace paths. If AWS Marketplace is preferred, we can coordinate to enable a private offer; if GCP/Azure is the preferred route, we can share the required listing checklist but time-to-live is typically longer.
- You confirm preferred commercial path (PO/card/marketplace) and procurement contact (this week)
- If PO: I'll route an order form + SOW for countersignature (Jonas will drive pricing approval)
- If AWS Marketplace: I’ll introduce our marketplace ops contact and prepare a private-offer packet
If it's helpful, happy to loop in our legal/ops folks on a quick call with procurement.
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call
Thanks Camila — great recap. A few answers below and a couple asks from procurement:

- Preferred commercial path: Procurement's default is PO/invoice for pilots > $25k, but the Platform team (me + Miguel) are okay exploring AWS Marketplace if it speeds up onboarding. For a pilot, PO would be easiest for our finance team unless the marketplace private offer can be issued and accepted within a week.

- Procurement contact & timeline: Please route PO paperwork to procure@nimbusai.com (CC me). They typically return a signed PO within 7–10 business days once they have an order form + SOW and SOC 2 evidence. If we go marketplace, I will work to get the internal approval but it may take longer to set up the private offer depending on AWS account mapping.

- Compliance asks: Procurement asked for a short SOC 2 cover memo and a standard MSA redline summary. Can you provide a one-page SOC 2 evidence summary and the typical MSA terms we use for marketplace/private-offer purchases?
- Billing method for pilot: We'll likely pay by PO. Card payments are reserved for small buys under $5k and not an option for this engagement.
Would appreciate the PO-ready order form and the one-page SOC 2 summary. Happy to schedule a short call with procurement next week if that helps accelerate.
Procurement Team note: procure@nimbusai.com — please confirm internal SLA for PO turnaround and any required PO fields (bill-to, ship-to, contract ref).
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call
Thanks Alicia — that's super helpful and aligned with what we expected. Quick update and actions from our side:
- SOC 2 summary & MSA: Attached a one-page SOC 2 cover memo and a short MSA summary that highlights our standard PO/invoice flow and marketplace private-offer terms.

- PO vs Marketplace: Since NimbusAI prefers PO for the pilot and procurement has a 7–10 business day SLA, we'll prepare a PO-ready order form + SOW (attached). Jonas is looped to confirm final pricing. If procurement later decides they want a private offer on AWS Marketplace, we can convert the same order form into a private-offer packet — that typically requires the buyer's AWS account ID and a short listing steps (we included that checklist).
- Next steps I will take now:
1) Share and route PO-ready order form + SOW to procure@nimbusai.com (today)
2) Send one-page SOC 2 memo and MSA summary (attached)
3) Standby to join a short procurement call next week if needed (Jonas and I available Thurs/Fri)

Alicia — can you confirm the PO fields procurement requires (bill-to address, legal entity name, PO reference) and whether your AWS account ID is available in case you want the private-offer fallback?
